title: 518. Sort Characters By Frequency

examples.explanation: e appears twice, t and r once each.
Equal frequencies allow either block order.
b appears twice, A and a once each.

hints: Count each character first; the rest is ordering by those counts.
Sorting distinct characters by descending count then repeating each by its count is simplest.
Bucketing by count gives linear time, but sorting distinct letters is fine for the given limits.
